core_obligations: Start from Hom_{PMod(O)}(O tensor_{p,f_pf_*O} f_pG, F). By the tensor-restrict adjunction for presheaves of modules this equals Hom_{PMod(f_pf_*O)}(f_pG, F_{f_pf_*O}) (proof lines 3074-3079, justified at 3086-3087). By the push-pull adjunction for abelian presheaves with module structures this equals Hom_{PMod(f_*O)}(G, f_*(F_{f_pf_*O})) (proof lines 3080-3082, justified at 3088-3089). Finally f_*(F_{f_pf_*O}) = f_*F as f_*O-modules: id_{f_*O} corresponds to c_O under the adjunction of the pullback-presheaves proof, giving id_{f_*O} = f_*c_O composed with i_{f_*O}, which makes the identification f_*O-linear (proof lines 3083-3096). Chaining gives the asserted bijection (proof lines 3074-3082).
proof_roadmap: Apply the tensor-restrict adjunction to move the tensor into the second argument (proof lines 3074-3079).
Apply the push-pull adjunction and identify f_*(F_{f_pf_*O}) = f_*F via the counit identity (proof lines 3080-3096).
